We evaluate the fairness of thirteen different Large Language Models (LLMs) in diverse domains: news, tweets, and reviews. Multi-document summarization (MDS) systems summarize the salient information from multiple documents about an entity.

quote: Performing human evaluation for fairness on summarization is challenging due to the need to read entire input document sets. Therefore, we perform experiments on the Amazon dataset... Each sample is annotated by three annotators recruited from Amazon Mechanical Turk...

Each sample is annotated by three annotators recruited from Amazon Mechanical Turk. Annotators read all reviews, identify all unique opinions, and then rate its fairness as leaning negative, fair, or leaning positive.
Each sample is annotated by three annotators recruited from Amazon Mechanical Turk. The annotators should be from English-speaking countries and have HIT Approval Rates greater than 98%.
